hits.title: The minimum degree of minimally k-extendable graphs for some k
hits.abstract_snippet: A graph on at least 2k+2 vertices is k-extendable if every matching of size k extends to a perfect matching, and it is minimally k-extendable if it is k-extendable but deleting any edge is not. Plummer proved that every k-extendable graph is (k+1)-connected. So its minimum degree is at least k+1. hits.title: Golomb rulers with real marks: the real and integer optima agree up to ten marks
hits.abstract_snippet: A Golomb ruler is a set of integer marks whose pairwise differences are distinct.
